A small comfort update.

## Improved
- The search bar now stays at the top while you scroll through results, so you can start a new search without scrolling back up.

## Install
- **Linux:** the `.deb` (recommended) or the `.AppImage`. With the `.AppImage`, install qBittorrent first: `sudo apt install qbittorrent-nox`.
- **Windows:** the `setup.exe`. Install [qBittorrent](https://www.qbittorrent.org/download) first.

Only download what you have the right to download.
